declared_before: final funding/OI novelty measurements landed (frozen while calm, P-6)

binding_constraints.mandatory_lane: plan section 2: lane 1 (A4 intraday, BTC/ETH) is the MANDATORY lane - if >= 1 lane-1 proposal survives all D2 gates, at least one lane-1 family MUST be selected
binding_constraints.diversity: the 2 selected families must come from different lanes (wave diversity binding)
binding_constraints.veto: any D2-measured veto (novelty pooled |rho|>0.20, COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT_FAIL_CLOSED, control identifiability FAIL) is DEAD - never argued away

rule_order.R1_dead: proposals dead at D2 (novelty veto / coverage fail / identifiability fail / data cannot fund S0) are removed - their slots are NOT reassigned to their own lane's sibling unless the sibling independently survives
rule_order.R2_rank: survivors ranked by declared A9-F quality: (a) honest fold population margin (events or decisions per fold vs floor 15), (b) control identifiability margin (structural distance anchor<->control), (c) cost-ceiling headroom (estimated per-event/per-state drift requirement vs the named 24bps tier-2.0 round trip), (d) mechanism independence from the published panel's forbidden proxies (worst measured pooled |rho|, lower is better)
rule_order.R3_pick: top-ranked lane-1 survivor (mandatory) + top-ranked survivor from a different lane; if lane 1 has no survivor, pick top 2 survivors from different lanes and DISCLOSE the mandatory-lane miss in the freeze

no_pnl: selection uses ZERO scored outcomes (all proposals pre-scoring); the freeze records proposal SHAs + arm digests
